race.comment: MRS BULL (5) was in the firing line on the corner and progressed nicely last start to finish a close third over 1400m at Dubbo after just missing the placings at the previous appearance. Mikayla Weir gets the best out of this seven-year-old mare. Likely improver with strong winning prospects. STREET SWAGGER (3) settled well back last time out then found the line strongly to finish 1.5 lengths away in fourth over 1400m at Bathurst. Has ability and a bold showing is expected. TAVIJEWEL (1) is first-up here but has won when fresh before and gets some weight relief with the claim. Could add some value at odds. PROCLIVITY (2) ran below expectations last time at Geurie over 1600m, finishing fourth and beaten 3.5 lengths. Should park just off the speed and rates among the leading chances from the low draw.
